Build passes now, exit 0. Fixed two bugs the dependency bump exposed:

1. `src/core/options.js` — reading `options.retries` when the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Crashed on `.toFixed()` of undefined.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` — strict boolean check threw on `undefined` flags instead of treating them as disabled.

The remaining 8 warnings are deprecation noise (`fs.exists`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) — not blocking, just cosmetic. Want those cleaned up too, or is unblocked-and-green enough for now?
